messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Social conditions and indicators and Youth in Germany during the 1980s?
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.

queries: GESIS youth Germany 1980s youth survey 1981 1985 dataset
German Youth Institute youth survey 1980s dataset Germany
German Socio Economic Panel 1984 dataset youth Germany SOEP

content.text: {"items":[{"title":"Youth Study 1986: Young People Aged 13–24 in Germany (Jugend-Studie 1986)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.1569","justification":"Highly relevant dataset examining the social conditions, attitudes, values, and living circumstances of young people aged 13–24 in Germany in 1986. Includes 1,060 respondents and 514 variables covering education, occupational aspirations, social mobility, family orientations, political attitudes, life satisfaction, and perceived opportunities. Particularly useful for analyzing youth experiences and social indicators in 1980s West Germany."},{"title":"Youth Welfare Study in Offenbach District, 1980 (Jugendhilfe-Untersuchung)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.1258","justification":"Survey of 3,080 young people aged 12–22 conducted in Offenbach, Hesse, during 1980. Investigates youth living conditions, leisure activities, family relationships, housing, social participation, and neighborhood environments. Provides detailed regional evidence about the social circumstances and everyday experiences of young people at the beginning of the 1980s."},{"title":"Youth in Leipzig 1982 (Jugend in Leipzig 1982)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.6114","justification":"East German dataset collected in 1982 by the Central Institute for Youth Research in Leipzig. Contains responses from 1,802 apprentices and young workers aged 16–30. Examines housing conditions, employment satisfaction, leisure activities, social participation, community attachment, and living standards. Particularly valuable for investigating youth social conditions in the German Democratic Republic (GDR)."},{"title":"Problems in Daily Life of Young People in the GDR, 1988 (Alltagsprobleme Jugendlicher in der DDR)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.6086","justification":"Directly addresses youth social conditions in East Germany during the late 1980s. Surveyed approximately 1,000 schoolchildren, apprentices, students, and young workers in 1988. Includes 196 variables covering life goals, living conditions, social relationships, future expectations, leisure opportunities, substance use, and satisfaction with everyday life. Especially useful for studying youth well-being and social challenges before German reunification."},{"title":"Complex Study 1984 (Komplexstudie 1984)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.6128","justification":"East German youth research dataset collected in 1984. Investigates young people's living conditions, housing, employment, working environments, leisure activities, social participation, personal values, and expectations for the future. Particularly relevant for understanding the relationship between occupational circumstances, social integration, and youth well-being in the GDR."},{"title":"Living Conditions and Support of Highly Gifted Schoolchildren, 1985–1988","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.6059","justification":"Study conducted in East Germany involving highly gifted schoolchildren and their parents, with data collected in 1985 and 1988. Examines educational opportunities, family environments, personal aspirations, social mobility, and educational support. Contains 892 variables and provides evidence about the relationship between family circumstances, schooling, and youth development during the 1980s. The sample is specialized rather than representative of all young people."},{"title":"Interval Study of Abilities and Career Development: Older Cohort, Third Wave, 1987","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.6124","justification":"Longitudinal youth development research conducted in East Germany, with this wave collected in 1987. Examines educational achievement, cognitive development, learning motivation, social orientations, personal aspirations, and environmental influences on young people's development. Useful for investigating educational inequalities and the social determinants of youth development during the 1980s."},{"title":"German General Social Survey (ALLBUS), 1980–1986 Cumulation","url_or_doi":"https://www.gesis.org/en/allbus/data-and-documentation","justification":"National social survey series containing data collected in West Germany in 1980, 1982, 1984, and 1986. Covers demographic characteristics, education, employment, family circumstances, social values, political attitudes, and other social indicators. The cumulative dataset allows comparisons across the early and middle 1980s. Particularly useful for analyzing young adults aged 18 and older in relation to the broader population. The landing page lists the 1980–1986 cumulative dataset under study number ZA1335."},{"title":"German General Social Survey (ALLBUS), 1980–2014 Cumulation","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA4584?lang=de","justification":"Longitudinally comparable collection of repeated cross-sectional surveys covering West Germany during the 1980s and unified Germany in later years. Includes observations from 1980, 1982, 1984, 1986, and 1988, allowing researchers to isolate the 1980s. Contains variables on education, employment, socioeconomic status, social attitudes, and demographic conditions. Particularly valuable for examining changes in social indicators among young adults aged 18 and older. The pre-1990 observations cover West Germany, including West Berlin."},{"title":"German Socio-Economic Panel (SOEP-Core), 1984–2014","url_or_doi":"https://www.diw.de/en/diw_01.c.592142.en/edition/soep-core_v31.1__update__data_1984-2014.html","justification":"Major longitudinal household survey beginning in West Germany in 1984. Contains detailed information on income, employment, education, household composition, housing, economic well-being, and life satisfaction. Data from 1984–1989 can be used to examine the socioeconomic circumstances of adolescents and young adults, including family resources and transitions into adulthood. Particularly useful for studying social inequality and changes in living standards over time."},{"title":"German Microcensus Trendfile: Historical Social and Demographic Indicators","url_or_doi":"https://www.gesis.org/en/gml/microcensus/microcensus-trendfile","justification":"Harmonized collection of German official microcensus data that includes observations from 1980, 1982, 1985, 1987, and 1989. Provides population-level information suitable for studying educational participation, employment patterns, household structures, demographic characteristics, and socioeconomic inequalities among young people. Especially useful for analyzing changes in youth social conditions across the 1980s using large, population-based samples. Historical observations from this period primarily concern West Germany."},{"title":"German Youth Institute Research Database: Family Survey, 1986–2000","url_or_doi":"https://www.dji.de/en/about-us/research-database.html","justification":"Research data repository maintained by the German Youth Institute containing the Family Survey series beginning in 1986. Offers information relevant to family structures, household circumstances, relationships, and the social environments in which children and adolescents grow up. The 1980s survey material can support research into family-related determinants of youth well-being and social conditions. The database provides documentation and access information for registered researchers."}]}
